subject: PLAN2.P3.8

procedure.procedure: После интеграции P3.8 выполнить каждый local acceptance phase.validation P3 V901… ровно на итоговом объединённом product tree. Создать @plan/artifacts/P3.8/phase-validation.json: каждый V# command/cwd/env/timestamps/exit/output/candidate+input closure, pending external owner gate отдельно. Не запускать повторно focused dir, покрытый тем же full run, кроме отдельно обязательной среды/negative control. Native plan.py finish checks этого последнего item должны включить V90 как acceptance carrier phase barrier. Для всех Pest lanes записать числовые discovered/matched/executed/passed/failed/skipped counts и names требуемых сценариев. Для required PG/MySQL V919/V920/V924/V925/V926 и filtered P3.3/V7/P3.4/V3: executed_tests>=1, skipped=0; миграция требует явного actual up/down output, гонки — barrier+distinct connection/pid proof. V90 проверяет counts/named scenario/output вместе с exit code; empty или skipped receipt reject. Documents PG cascade V925 и share revoke PG filter V926 обязательны на final tree; NodeSequenceBoundaryTest обязателен внутри V920. Сквозной receipt сохраняет reused vs executed с input closure. Supplemental phase V930–V932 cover actual legacy Document sequence and inline egress/strict scanner scope. C-row receipt maps current P3 contribution; validate required SEC names and every no-skip schema/race count, not merely exit. Broad run may cover focused files once; different required DB/negative control lanes remain distinct.

observation: All 32 local phase checks qualified; actual schema up/down and independent PG backend/barrier stdout receipts in phase-actual-proofs.json. Required named PG/MySQL lanes executed>=1, failed0, skipped0. Reused input closures and focused supplements explicit; 95 SQLite opt-in/PG skips inventoried, not counted as passing. Hosted O-3 and independent P3 phase audit/future correction owners remain pending.
